description: When one funder's calls usually open and close, and the typical window from opening to deadline, from its past calls listed on Raise Lens. Shown only when there are at least 3 past calls with both dates; a pattern from past calls, not a forecast. Includes the decision time when the funder states one.

url_or_slug.description: A Raise Lens funder slug, or its raiselens.com/funders URL.

name: funder_rhythm

decision_time.description: As the funder states it; never estimated.

opening_pattern.description: usual (months that repeat) or spread (no month repeats).

rhythm.description: null with fewer than 3 past calls.

title: Funder call rhythm
